========================================================= // DROPDOWN REF // ========================================================= const dropdownRef = useRef(null) // ========================================================= // LOAD DEFAULT VALUES // ========================================================= useEffect(() => { if (!open) { setSelectedAgent('') setSelectedRM('') setSelectedLoanType('') setOpenDropdown(null) setAgentSearch('') setRMSearch('') setLoanTypeSearch('') return } /* * When multiple applications are selected, * only use a value if all selected applications * currently have the same value. */ const getCommonValue = (items, getter) => { if (!items.length) { return '' } const values = items .map(getter) .filter( (value) => value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '' ) .map((value) => String(value)) if (!values.length) { return '' } const firstValue = values[0] if ( values.every( (value) => value === firstValue ) ) { return firstValue } return '' } const commonAgent = getCommonValue( applications, (application) => application.agentId ?? application.agent_id ?? application.agent?.id ?? application.agentName ?? application.agent_name ?? application.agent?.name ) const commonRM = getCommonValue( applications, (application) => application.rmId ?? application.rm_id ?? application.rm?.id ?? application.rmName ?? application.rm_name ?? application.rm?.name ) const commonLoanType = getCommonValue( applications, (application) => application.loanType ) setSelectedAgent(commonAgent) setSelectedRM(commonRM) setSelectedLoanType(commonLoanType) }, [open, applications]) // ========================================================= // CLOSE DROPDOWN ON OUTSIDE CLICK // ========================================================= useEffect(() => { const handleOutsideClick = (event) => { if ( dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains( event.target ) ) { setOpenDropdown(null) } } if (openDropdown) { document.addEventListener( 'mousedown', handleOutsideClick ) } return () => { document.removeEventListener( 'mousedown', handleOutsideClick ) } }, [openDropdown]) // ========================================================= // FILTER AGENTS // ========================================================= const filteredAgents = useMemo(() => { const value = agentSearch .trim() .toLowerCase() if (!value) { return agents } return agents.filter( (agent) => String( agent.name || '' ) .toLowerCase() .includes(value) ) }, [agents, agentSearch]) // ========================================================= // FILTER RMS // ========================================================= const filteredRMs = useMemo(() => { const value = rmSearch .trim() .toLowerCase() if (!value) { return rms } return rms.filter( (rm) => String( rm.name || '' ) .toLowerCase() .includes(value) ) }, [rms, rmSearch]) // ========================================================= // FILTER LOAN TYPES // ========================================================= const filteredLoanTypes = useMemo(() => { const value = loanTypeSearch .trim() .toLowerCase() if (!value) { return loanTypes } return loanTypes.filter( (loanType) => String(loanType) .toLowerCase() .includes(value) ) }, [loanTypes, loanTypeSearch]) // ========================================================= // SELECT AGENT // ========================================================= const handleAgentSelect = (agent) => { setSelectedAgent( String(agent.id) ) setOpenDropdown(null) setAgentSearch('') } // ========================================================= // SELECT RM // ========================================================= const handleRMSelect = (rm) => { setSelectedRM( String(rm.id) ) setOpenDropdown(null) setRMSearch('') } // ========================================================= // SELECT LOAN TYPE // ========================================================= const handleLoanTypeSelect = (loanType) => { setSelectedLoanType(loanType) setOpenDropdown(null) setLoanTypeSearch('') } // ========================================================= // GET SELECTED NAMES // ========================================================= const selectedAgentName = agents.find( (agent) => String(agent.id) === String(selectedAgent) )?.name || '' const selectedRMName = rms.find( (rm) => String(rm.id) === String(selectedRM) )?.name || '' // ========================================================= // SUBMIT // ========================================================= const handleSubmit = (event) => { event.preventDefault() if ( !selectedAgent && !selectedRM && !selectedLoanType ) { return } onSubmit?.({ agentId: selectedAgent || null, agentName: selectedAgentName || null, rmId: selectedRM || null, rmName: selectedRMName || null, loanType: selectedLoanType || null, }) } // ========================================================= // CLOSE // ========================================================= const handleClose = () => { setOpenDropdown(null) onClose?.() } // ========================================================= // MODAL // ========================================================= if (!open) { return null }
